newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Energy, KCS Energy resolve dispute.
newsitem.headline: El Paso Energy, KCS Energy resolve dispute.

text.p: El Paso Energy Corp said on Tuesday that it agreed to dismiss its lawsuits against KCS Energy Inc over disputed gas purchase contracts.

This action terminates KCS's further challenge to a jury's verdict entered recently in Tennessee Gas Pipeline's favor in the case, El Paso said. El Paso acquired Tenneco Energy, the parent of Tennessee Gas Pipeline, from Tenneco Inc.

KCS agreed to the early termination of the natural gas purchase contract that was set to expire in 1999, ending the company's contractual obligation to pay more than $50 million of premium prices for future natural gas purchases, El Paso said.
The settlement also lowers the total gas supply realignment costs to be paid by customers of Tennessee Gas Pipeline, the company said.
